reason: The source change reduces the MIP strong-branching LP iteration budget before two restarts. It changes an internal search policy rather than a user parameter or model, and can alter pseudocost information, node selection, proof time, and per-node work.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: Spending fewer LP iterations on early strong branching may reduce overhead per branch and improve time to a valid bound, but weaker early branch estimates may enlarge the search tree.
causal_chain: The PR quarters sbmaxiters while numRestarts is at most two; this changes the amount of strong-branching evidence before a branch choice, which can redirect later pseudocosts, nodes, and dual-bound progress.
structural_trigger: Hard MIP instances with strong branching active before or at the second restart; cases with no strong-branching calls or only later restarts are controls.
activation_probe: Count early and later strong-branch calls, actual LP iterations and sbmaxiters, restart index, branch decisions, nodes, and dual bounds on paired pinned builds.
instance_selection_rule: Freeze binary knapsack and scheduling MIP cases by size and baseline difficulty before hidden scoring; retain weak/no-strong-branch controls, fixed seeds, budgets, and all timeouts.
workload_exposure_plan: Use the shared HiGHS exact MIP driver, trace the budget branch on public cases, then independently verify original-model solutions, bounds, statuses, and optimality claims.
mathematical_risk: Truncated LP solves must not be treated as certified bounds or allow false pruning; changed branch choice can also expose numerical or completeness regressions.
independent_check_plan: Check primal assignments against original MIP constraints and integrality, validate claimed dual bounds and infeasibility or optimality statuses against independent certificates on tractable cases, and retain all timeout outcomes.
hidden_generalization_plan: Compare verified solved coverage, proof time, and valid timeout-bound progress on paired held-out MIP structures and seeds, reporting severe per-family regressions.
overlap_review: Earlier HiGHS #618 changes directional reliability at a different historical snapshot; #690 and #693 address cuts and implications. This PR targets the early strong-branching iteration budget and counts once despite multiple seeds.
resource_risk: Cheaper early branch probes can increase total nodes or later LP work even when each strong-branch call gets faster.
